messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — elevated 5xx rate detected on prod/api-gateway (source: uptime-probe). Symptoms: spike in 502/504, upstream timeouts. Affected services: auth-service, org-lookup, billing-config. Severity: P1. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/incidents/1887654321
maya: ack — I'm oncall. Gathering context. Who pushed config to auth/token flow around 13:45 UTC?
leo: I'm looking. Seeing a flood of upstream 502s from auth-service pod auth-abc-3. Sample proxy log:
```
[04/Mar/2026:14:12:31 +0000] "POST /v1/complete" 502 523 "-" "upstream: http://auth-service:5000/verify -> 502 Bad Gateway"
```
dina: I was paged too. There's a config push at 13:50 UTC to configurator that touched token rotation TTL. Rolling that back now.
alex: FYI support is getting a bunch of reports — oauths failing, embeddings/generate returning 502.
james: support -> several customers (enterprise + small) reporting signup failures and ingestion timeouts, tagging @acct-team for notifications.
maya: Runbook: step 1 — confirm auth-service health + restart unhealthy pods. I'll also flip gateway to use stale-auth-cache fallback while we triage.
leo: executing checks:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=auth-service
kubectl -n prod logs auth-abc-3 -c app --tail=200
```
Logs show repeated token-db timeouts: "timeout while waiting for response from token-db: context deadline exceeded". I'll delete the failing pod to force a restart.
dina: rollback in progress: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/configurator --to-revision=43` — rollback command submitted.
maya: applying quick traffic mitigation: update gateway route to use stale-auth-cache for /verify for 10m to reduce sync calls.
``
redwoodctl gateway set-route --service api-gateway --route /verify --fallback stale-auth-cache --ttl 600
```
leo: pod restarted, auth-service is up but still shows degraded 200/5xx ratio. I'm increasing connection pool and extending upstream timeout to 12s as a temporary patch.
alex: deployed a temporary filter on gateway to return 503+Retry-After for low-priority bulk embedding requests to shed load.
james: impact metrics: peak error rate ~15% at 14:12 UTC, after stale-cache flip error rate down to ~3% within 5 minutes. Customers with OAuth flows most affected.
maya: Hand-off plan: I'll own P1 until 22:00 UTC and then hand to leo for full RCA. Immediate action items: (1) confirm rollback fully propagated; (2) DB team to inspect token-db slow queries; (3) platform to add pre-deploy checks for token rotation. Postmortem owner: dina.
leo: will dig into token-db query plans and connection saturation. Also schedule a canary for configurator deploys with automatic traffic diversion if auth errors rise.
dina: rollback confirmed, config-service restarted, metrics show auth latency and 5xx dropping back to baseline. Creating postmortem doc and adding remediation items.
incident-bot: Mitigation update — 10m avg 5xx down to 0.8%. No active customer-facing pages. Marking pager as mitigated.
maya: closing from on-call. Thanks everyone for the quick coord :tada:
